verdicts.why: S3E11 'Reunion': Nadeem lets the NYPD take Karen, then Matt helps him fight off Fisk's men at his home and unmasks to him; the lawyer/grand jury work and his death by Poindexter are S3E12. (They also team up briefly in E7-E8, which may deserve its own earlier stage.)

value.title: Daredevil S2#8
value.text: Ray Schoonover testifies as a character witness at Frank Castle's trial, where Matt and Foggy are Castle's lawyers.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A defense witness at Castle's trial.

split.title: Daredevil S2#12
split.text: Schoonover turns out to be the Blacksmith, the sniper whose attack on District Attorney Reyes nearly killed Matt and his friends.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A defense witness at Castle's trial, whose sniper attack nearly kills Matt.
split.on_b_card_about_a: One of Castle's lawyers, whom Schoonover's sniper attack nearly kills.

verdicts.why: Schoonover testifies for Castle's defense, questioned by Foggy, in S2E8 'Guilty as Sin', and his Blacksmith reveal is S2E12, so the split is right. But at E8 he is a witness on Matt's side, so kind enemy is wrong for that stage; it should be ally.
The fixed Creel vs. Jack Murdock fight, Jack winning and being murdered for it, is shown in the S1E2 'Cut Man' flashbacks; Matt's breakdown to Stick is S1E7.
Melvin fits Owlsley's armored suit for Fisk in S1E8 'Shadows in the Glass' ('Need anything else, Mr. Fisk, sir?'); the Betsy threat is revealed in S1E11.

value.title: Daredevil S1#7
value.text: Stick attacks Nobu's men at the docks to stop the delivery of Black Sky, then catches the van and kills the boy, to Nobu's fury.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The blind warrior who attacks Nobu's Black Sky delivery and kills the boy.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The man bringing Black Sky to New York, whose delivery Stick attacks.

split.title: Daredevil S2#12
split.text: Stick has spent his life fighting the Hand, and Nobu is one of its leaders in New York. Nobu has the Hand kidnap Stick and question him about the Chaste.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Hand's lifelong foe, whom Nobu has kidnapped.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A Hand leader who has Stick kidnapped and questioned.

split.title: Daredevil S2#13
split.text: After Matt Murdock defeats Nobu, Stick cuts off his head so he cannot rise again.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The Hand's lifelong foe, who cuts off Nobu's head.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A Hand leader whose head Stick cuts off so he cannot rise again.

verdicts.why: They are already enemies in S1E7 'Stick': Stick and Matt attack Nobu's Black Sky delivery, Nobu orders them killed, and Stick kills the boy, so S2E12 is too late. The kidnapping is S2E12 and the beheading S2E13, so those are split out (the beheading must not sit at E12).

value.title: Daredevil S1#5
value.text: Nobu represents the Hand in Fisk's alliance and reminds Fisk of the promises he made to the people Nobu represents.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The crime boss whose alliance Nobu sits in for the Hand.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The Hand's man in Fisk's alliance.

split.title: Daredevil S1#9
split.text: Nobu pushes Fisk to clear the tenants from a building the Hand wants. Fisk lures Daredevil into a fight with Nobu that ends with Nobu burning.
split.on_a_card_about_b: An ally who lures Daredevil into the fight that leaves Nobu burning.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The Hand's man in Fisk's alliance, pushing him to clear a building.

verdicts.why: Fisk first meets Nobu and the alliance at the car shop in S1E5 'World on Fire', where Nobu reminds him of his promises; the building demand and Pier 81 trap are S1E9. The proposal left the old card line on Fisk's card ('pushing him to clear a building'), which is an E9 fact, so it is cut back.
Seema is at Sami's birthday party with the declined card and money worries in S3E1 'Resurrection'; Ray is killed in S3E12.

value.title: Daredevil S3#9
value.text: Wilson Fisk blackmails FBI agent Ray Nadeem into serving him.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An FBI agent Fisk blackmails into serving him.

split.title: Daredevil S3#11
split.text: Nadeem turns on Fisk by letting the police take Karen Page, and Fisk's men attack his family.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The crime boss Nadeem turns on after being blackmailed into serving him.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An FBI agent Fisk blackmails, who turns on him.

split.title: Daredevil S3#13
split.text: Fisk has Nadeem killed, but Nadeem's recorded dying declaration exposes Fisk's crimes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Blackmails Nadeem into serving him, until Nadeem records a dying declaration.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An FBI agent Fisk blackmails, who exposes him in a dying declaration.

verdicts.why: Hattley frames Nadeem for Winn's murder and tells him he now works for Fisk in S3E9 'Revelations', so E9 is right, but the dying declaration is released in S3E13 and must be split out. Nadeem also betrays Fisk in S3E11, which ends the boss stage.
Reyes cross-examines Schoonover when he testifies for Castle in S2E8 'Guilty as Sin'; he is unmasked as the Blacksmith in S2E12, so the shooting stays there.
Rosalie compliments Vanessa at the Fisks' wedding reception in S3E13 'A New Napkin'; she is only in S3E9 and E13.
Rosalie is rounded up and taken to Fisk's Red Fish Blue meeting, where she asks how to pay for his protection, in S3E9 'Revelations'.
Fisk meets Vanessa over 'Rabbit in a Snowstorm' at the gallery in S1E3; the dinner and Anatoly interruption are S1E4.

value.title: Daredevil S3#12
value.text: Vanessa returns to New York and asks Fisk to let her into the criminal side of his life, and he does.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Vanessa's fiance, who lets her into his criminal life.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's fiancee and new partner in crime.

split.title: Daredevil S3#13
split.text: Fisk marries Vanessa after his release, and she becomes his partner in both life and crime.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Vanessa's husband and partner in life and crime.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Fisk's wife and partner in life and crime.

verdicts.why: Vanessa returns and joins the criminal side of Fisk's life in S3E12 'One Last Shot', but the wedding is S3E13, so the marriage text and husband/wife cards must be split out to E13.
Mahoney's team storms the penthouse and arrests Fisk and Vanessa in S3E13 'A New Napkin'.
Elektra hides and listens while Karen talks with Matt that night in S2E7 'Semper Fidelis'; Karen finds her in Matt's bed in S2E8.

value.title: Daredevil S1#5
value.text: Marci works at Landman and Zack, the firm Matt and Foggy turned down, and opposes them in Elena Cardenas' case.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A Landman and Zack lawyer who opposes Matt and Foggy.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Foggy's partner, whose case Marci opposes.

split.title: Daredevil S1#12
split.text: Marci agrees to help and sends Landman and Zack files that help Matt and Foggy take down Fisk.
split.on_a_card_about_b: A Landman and Zack lawyer who opposes Matt and Foggy, then helps.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Foggy's partner, whose case Marci opposes before helping.

verdicts.why: Marci first opposes Nelson and Murdock in the Cardenas case in S1E5 'World on Fire', but she only agrees to help and starts sending Landman and Zack documents in S1E12, so that part is split out.

value.title: Daredevil S1#6
value.text: Claire treats Mrs. Cardenas when Foggy and Karen bring her into the hospital after the bombings.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The nurse who treats Mrs. Cardenas after the bombings.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A lawyer who brings Mrs. Cardenas to Claire's hospital.

split.title: Daredevil S1#10
split.text: When Foggy unmasks a badly hurt Matt, he calls Claire to patch him up, and she reveals she has known Matt's secret all along.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The nurse Foggy calls to patch Matt up. Knew Matt's secret all along.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's best friend, who calls Claire when Matt is badly hurt.

verdicts.why: Claire treats Elena Cardenas when Foggy and Karen bring her in after the bombings in S1E6, but Foggy calling Claire to Matt and her revealing she knew his secret is S1E10 'Nelson v. Murdock', so it is split out.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#2
value.text: Karen captures Alan Saunders, an Anti-Vigilante Task Force officer, when he goes looking for her and Daredevil during the raid on Josie's Bar.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A task force officer Karen captures.

split.title: Daredevil: Born Again S2#3
split.text: Saunders tells Karen and Daredevil he wants to help and gives them his Red Hook key card.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who captures Saunders. He later turns and helps Daredevil.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A task force officer Karen captures, who later helps Daredevil.

verdicts.why: Karen subdues and bags the AVTF officer at the end of S2E2 'Shoot the Moon', and he offers help and his key card in S2E3, so the split is right. At E2 she has only taken him hostage, so kind ally is wrong for that stage; it should be enemy.
Saunders first appears as one of Fisk's AVTF officers on patrol during the blackout in Born Again S1E9 'Straight to Hell'.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#3
value.text: Hector Ayala is Angela del Toro's uncle, and at his trial she learns he is the White Tiger.

split.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#6
split.text: After Hector's death, Angela sets out to finish his search for the city's missing people.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Angela's uncle, the White Tiger, whose unfinished search she takes up.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Hector's niece, who sets out to finish his search after his death.

verdicts.why: Angela attends Hector's trial and learns he is White Tiger in Born Again S1E3, but her taking up his search for the missing people is S1E6 'Excessive Force', so the text and both cards would spoil it at E3 and are split out.
Matt stops and comforts Angela at the morgue in Born Again S1E4 'Sic Semper Systema'; he rescues her from Muse in S1E6.
Angela takes the amulet in Born Again S2E2 and first fights alongside Daredevil and Karen in the Red Hook prison break in S2E3.
Soledad and Angela live together and attend Hector's trial together in Born Again S1E3; the hospital visit is S1E7.
The AVTF arrests Soledad at the bodega and Angela takes Hector's amulet from McDuffie's office in Born Again S2E2 'Shoot the Moon'.
Mahoney is only in Born Again S2E7-E8, and he and Kim approach the courthouse doors together in S2E8 'The Southern Cross'.
Kim is part of the honest officers who form the resistance with Daredevil at Josie's in Born Again S1E9 'Straight to Hell'.
BB tells Fisk she was named for her uncle Ben Urich in Born Again S1E2 'Optics'; her knowing Fisk was the main suspect in his murder is S1E8.
Buck opens Fisk's door to BB at City Hall and gives her five minutes in Born Again S1E2 'Optics'.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#2
value.text: Daniel Blake, a staffer for Mayor Fisk, falls for journalist BB Urich, and she befriends him as her inside source at City Hall.

split.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#8
split.text: Daniel pushes BB hard to change her Daredevil story, but the two stay close.
split.on_a_card_about_b: BB's inside source at City Hall, who falls for her.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist Daniel falls for, and a close friend.

verdicts.why: BB first uses Daniel to get her meeting with Fisk in Born Again S1E2 'Optics', but his pressure on her to change her Daredevil story is S1E7 and their making up at the ball is S1E8, so that sentence is split out.
Ellison is only mentioned in Born Again S2E6 and appears in S2E8 'The Southern Cross', where he welcomes BB to the Bulletin with Ben's clippings.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#2
value.text: BB Urich covers Fisk on her online show and gets a meeting with him at City Hall, giving him exposure.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor BB covers and interviews.
value.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist who covers and interviews Fisk.

split.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#8
split.text: BB, who knows Fisk was the main suspect in her uncle's murder, reveals she is secretly working from the inside to take him down.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The mayor BB interviews while secretly working to take him down.
split.on_b_card_about_a: A journalist who interviews Fisk and secretly works against him.

verdicts.why: BB meets Fisk at City Hall in Born Again S1E2 and reveals in S1E8 that she is working from the inside against him, so the move and split are right. But in E8 Gallo says Fisk was the main suspect in Ben's murder; the split should not say she knows Fisk was behind it.
BB's final City Without Fear broadcast exposing the Fisk organization's role in Blake's murder is in Born Again S2E8.
At the Black and White Ball in Born Again S1E8 'Isle of Joy', Buck tells Fisk that Poindexter has escaped and covers the Fisks when he attacks; Poindexter's shot hits Buck in S2E8.
Mr. Charles recruits Poindexter and flies out of New York with him after Fisk's exile in Born Again S2E8.

value.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#8
value.text: Vanessa Fisk hired Benjamin Poindexter to kill Foggy Nelson. Poindexter turns on the Fisks and attacks their ball at Gracie Mansion.
value.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who hired Poindexter to kill Foggy.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman Vanessa hired, who turns on her.

split.title: Daredevil: Born Again S1#9
split.text: Vanessa had Poindexter released so he would kill Foggy and keep the Red Hook port secret.
split.on_a_card_about_b: The woman who frees Poindexter and hires him to kill Foggy.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The hitman Vanessa frees and hires, who turns on her.

verdicts.why: Matt works out that Vanessa hired Poindexter to kill Foggy, and Poindexter attacks the ball, in Born Again S1E8. But her having him released is shown in the S1E9 flashback, and the Red Hook free-port secret is uncovered in S1E9, so those facts are split out.
Poindexter's attack at Fogwell's Gym, Vanessa shooting him and the shard hitting her head, is Born Again S2E4; she dies after surgery in S2E5.
Mahoney tells Powell the police serve the people and Powell orders North to fire at the courthouse doors in Born Again S2E8; they share no earlier scene.
Fisk orders Buck to kill Matt and Buck finds the hospital room empty in Born Again S1E9 'Straight to Hell'.
In Born Again S2E4 Mr. Charles brings two armed men to pressure Fisk over the delayed weapons and Buck kills them and holds him at gunpoint; Fisk only takes the weapons from the CIA in S2E6.
Daredevil boards the Northern Star and Savva and the captain scuttle it in Born Again S2E1, a hostile meeting; Savva testifies and is killed by Buck in S2E4.
